docs.summary: Imports TrueType (.ttf) and OpenType (.otf) font files as FontAsset resources. The raw font bytes are embedded in the asset so Scribe can reconstruct the FontFile and generate glyph atlases at runtime.
Version number for cache invalidation. Bump when import logic changes.
Reads the font file at ctx.AbsolutePath, creates a FontAsset from its raw bytes, and sets it as the main asset. Returns true on success, false on failure.
